craft_notes: Sthāyin: attainment-fruit (first fruit verse of the closing arc: ajara-amara as double negative). Sanskrit: ajarāmaratāṃ yāti...yoginīvallabhaḥ → L4 keeps attains-endowed line 1, dear-lord line 2. Rows: row 3 (endowed→lord). Close: lord (vallabha — the dear-lord word; end-weight doctrine noun). Rejected: 'immortality' — killed: ageless deathlessness kept (two negatives, not one positive); 'siddhis' for atom-qualities — killed: aṇimādi kept plain (the text's measure-word, not the power-fantasy).

lines: Ageless deathlessness he attains, atom-qualities endowed:
of yoginīs dear — the all-gathering lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ajarāmaratām eti so 'ṇimādiguṇānvitaḥ | yoginīnām priyo devi sarvamelāpakādhipaḥ

reads_against.argmap: Who attains agelessness? → Endowed with atomic qualities, he gathers all — yoginīs' dear lord.
c1_essence: Ageless he attains: all-gathering lord of yoginīs.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vīra with śānta (resolve closing the practice arc)
